_about: Every look and format in this library. Both skills read this file to match what a member says ('edit this in the Codie look') to a folder. name = the gallery name; also = other ways people say it.

items.name: Just you
items.title: Just you
items.one_liner: Your face, a big boxed hook, small captions, and one real picture only when you name something.

items.name: Full
items.title: Full
items.inspired_by: a busier version of Just you
items.one_liner: Just you, turned up: punch-ins, a numbered list card, accent keywords and (optional) stickers of your own art, one at a time.

items.name: Hormozi classic
items.title: Bold Word Pop
items.one_liner: Huge all-caps captions with the spoken word lit up, a punch-in every second or two, zero dead air, no music.

items.name: Hormozi 2026
items.title: Red Tag Desk Talk
items.one_liner: A red label tag for the first 4.5 s, small sentence-case captions that hard-swap, and a list card that un-redacts point by point as you say it.

items.name: Codie Sanchez
items.title: Studio editorial
items.one_liner: Quiet, expensive founder look: a bold serif lead-in over a light sans line that types on as you speak, a warm grade, hard cuts between two framings and a soft music bed. Nothing bounces.
items.edits_native: alternate 1.00 / 1.18 framing on each cut; warm grade

items.name: Diary of a CEO
items.title: Podcast clip
items.inspired_by: inspired by The Diary of a CEO (@thediaryofaceo)
items.one_liner: A dark, moody podcast clip: the hook is on screen from the first frame, short captions sit under your chin, a profile card says who you are, and the last line fades to black and white.
items.config: the CLAUDE CHANGES PER TAKE blocks in cut.py and build.py
needs: a closed-mouth 'listening' moment from the same take (the react shot)
items.edits_native: three crops (1.0 / 1.2 / 1.3) switched on each join; B&W on the last line

items.name: Nana Del Rey
items.title: Soft Cinema
items.one_liner: Slow, warm and filmic: giant butter-yellow words build word by word behind your head, and thin cream lowercase subtitles fill the air above you, left to right.
needs: the person cut-out (made by `hyperframes remove-background`, slow)

items.name: Mariah Brunner
items.title: Receipts Round Your Head
items.one_liner: You stay on screen talking like you're on FaceTime with a friend, while the proof pops in around your head: a real screenshot, a reaction GIF, butter-yellow keywords and a numbered card, each landing on the exact word you say.
needs: their own logos, screenshots and a reaction clip (or the editing pack)

items.name: Nick Saraev
items.title: The Recompose
items.one_liner: The frame rearranges itself around every sentence: your face, then a split with the thing you mean, then the real proof full screen, then back to you.
needs: real pages or screenshots of what they talk about
items.edits_native: the clip shrinks/moves for split and full-screen beats (SPEC keyframes)

items.name: Iman Gadzhi
items.title: Value-only motion
items.one_liner: Your face does the talking; graphics only fire on the claims, numbers and numbered steps, so every one feels like a reward.
needs: `npx hyperframes add hw-write-title` once in the build folder (pen strokes)
items.edits_native: nothing extra; never more than 35% of the reel animated

items.name: Calm luxury
items.title: Calm luxury
items.one_liner: The camera never moves, only you do: one small white serif line, warm window light, hard cuts, no effects, and it loops.
items.edits_native: almost everything (locked frame, one serif line, no SFX)

items.name: Pop-up proof
items.title: Pop-up proof
items.one_liner: Your real proof pops up in white cards while the camera shrinks back to make room, with giant words behind your head and bold karaoke captions.
needs: optional: the person cut-out for words behind the head

items.name: Text over B-roll
items.title: Text over B-roll
items.one_liner: Calm everyday footage, slowed and warm-graded, with one lowercase line written like a text to a friend.
items.config: CLIPS in cut.py + LINES in build.py

items.name: Serialised episode
items.title: Serialised episode
items.one_liner: Same shot, same badge, same sound every time; only the number and the topic change, so viewers come back for the next one.
items.config: EPISODE block in build.py + SRC/KEEP/SPEED/SCRIPT in cut.py

items.name: Before-and-after
items.title: Before-and-after reveal
items.one_liner: Open on the worst version with a question, show the real fix in quick one-second beats, then flash into the result and hold.
items.config: the per-take block in cut.py + REVEAL in build.py

items.name: POV skit
items.title: POV micro-skit
items.one_liner: A native white-pill "POV:" line while you act out a moment your clients know, then one hard punch-in on your reaction.

items.name: Green-screen proof
items.title: Green-screen proof
items.one_liner: You talk in front of the real page you're reacting to, with a highlighter hook, a source chip and a red pen mark on the exact line as you say it.
needs: real web pages to screenshot (shots.py, needs Playwright)
the person cut-out (made by `hyperframes remove-background`, slow)

items.name: Timestamp vlog
items.title: Timestamp vlog
items.one_liner: Short clips stamped with their real recorded time in the same spot, the same swipe between every clip, a warm daylight look and a shutter on the last shot.
needs: vlog clips from through the day

items.name: Yes… but
items.title: Yes… but split
items.one_liner: Top half is the dream, bottom half is the catch: meme labels, two opposite colour grades, and BUT landing a beat late with a record scratch.
